schema.description:
GetWorkspaceUsageResponse is the workspace usage report: a point-in-time
snapshot of who is running how many active sessions, on how many vCPUs and
how much memory, split by OS.

computeQuotas.description:
The workspace's vCPU quota and current use per machine family, listing
only the families its plan gives a quota. Use is counted from the
workspace's machines, so it can briefly differ from the session totals
while a session shuts down. Empty when the quota could not be read; the
session totals are still returned.

items.description:
ComputeQuota is the workspace's vCPU quota on one machine family and how
much of it is in use.

displayName.description: Human-readable family name, for example "M2 Pro".

family.description: Machine family identifier, for example "m2pro" or "linux-lc01".

os.description:
Operating system of the family's machines: "macos" or "linux". Empty
when the machine catalog could not be read or does not know the family.

quotaVcpu.description:
The workspace's vCPU quota on this family, set by its plan. Always
positive: families without a quota are left out.

usedVcpu.description:
vCPUs held right now by the workspace's machines in this family, warm
pool sessions included. Starting a session is refused when its machine
would take this past quota_vcpu.

memoryGb.description: Total memory in GB across those sessions; unknown specs contribute 0.

sessionCount.description:
Number of active sessions (VM still consuming resources: starting,
running, terminating, or draining).

vcpu.description:
Total vCPUs across those sessions. Sessions whose machine type carries
no parseable spec contribute 0 (see unknown_machine_type_count).

memoryGb.description: Total memory in GB across those sessions; unknown specs contribute 0.

sessionCount.description:
Number of active sessions (VM still consuming resources: starting,
running, terminating, or draining).

vcpu.description:
Total vCPUs across those sessions. Sessions whose machine type carries
no parseable spec contribute 0 (see unknown_machine_type_count).

unknown.description:
Usage on sessions whose operating system could not be determined from
the session's machine type or stack. Kept separate so linux and macos
never silently absorb guesses.

memoryGb.description: Total memory in GB across those sessions; unknown specs contribute 0.

sessionCount.description:
Number of active sessions (VM still consuming resources: starting,
running, terminating, or draining).

vcpu.description:
Total vCPUs across those sessions. Sessions whose machine type carries
no parseable spec contribute 0 (see unknown_machine_type_count).

unknownMachineTypeCount.description:
Number of active sessions whose machine type had no resolvable vCPU/RAM
spec — those sessions are counted in session counts but contribute 0 to
the vcpu/memory sums, so totals may undercount when this is non-zero.

users.description:
Per-user breakdown, plus at most one workspace-owned bucket row.
Sorted by email for determinism; clients re-sort freely.

items.description: UserUsage is one row of the per-user usage breakdown.

email.description: The user's email address (empty for the workspace-owned bucket).

isWorkspace.description:
True for the single aggregate row of sessions owned by the workspace
itself rather than by an individual user (for example sessions spawned
by a preview link).

sessions.description:
The active sessions behind this row's totals, oldest first.
Filled only for a workspace on the 'rde-admin-terminate-any-session'
rollout flag (see GetWorkspaceInfoResponse.can_terminate_any_session);
empty otherwise.

items.description:
UsageSession is one active session in the usage report: just enough to
decide whether to terminate it (TerminateSession with its id).

createdAt.description:
When the session was created: its age. A session terminated and
restored since keeps its original creation time.

heldByWarmPoolId.description:
Set when the session is held by a pool rather than by anyone using it:
unclaimed inventory (booted, waiting to be claimed) or the debug VM a
pool keeps after its setup failed. The ID of that pool. Such a session
cannot be terminated directly — lower the pool's pool_size
(UpdateWarmPool) or retry the pool instead. Empty for every other
session, including ones already claimed from a pool.

machineType.description: Machine type the session runs on.

memoryGb.description: Memory of the machine in GB; 0 when the machine type's spec is unknown.

os.description:
Operating system of the session's machine: "linux" or "macos". Empty
when it could not be determined (counted in UsageTotals.unknown).

status.description: Live status of the session: starting, running, terminating or draining.

vcpu.description: vCPUs of the machine; 0 when the machine type's spec is unknown.

totals.description: This row's usage, split by OS platform.

memoryGb.description: Total memory in GB across those sessions; unknown specs contribute 0.

running, terminating, or draining).

userId.description:
Internal identifier of the user (empty for the workspace-owned bucket).
Use user_slug to reference the user in other Bitrise APIs.

userSlug.description:
The user's Bitrise slug, usable with other Bitrise APIs. Best-effort:
may be empty, so do not treat emptiness as marking the workspace-owned
bucket — use is_workspace for that.

username.description: The user's Bitrise username. Best-effort: may be empty.
